title: DischargeSim: A Simulation Benchmark for Educational Doctor–Patient Communication at Discharge

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing LLM DoctorAgent performance (e.g., language delivery, human-centered communication, and strategy use) when interacting with simulated PatientAgents configured with low versus high health literacy profiles.

Evaluating disparities in LLM-generated responses across simulated patients with different educational backgrounds (no high school, high school/GED, and college graduate) to measure sensitivity to patient education levels.
Measuring variations in LLM response quality, empathy, and conversational strategy when interacting with simulated patients exhibiting deflective, neutral, or anxious emotional styles.
